title: Q3
description:
“He who built the house has more honor than the house.”
Read: 2Sa 7:11–13, Zec 6:12–13
a) David's son was promised: “He shall build a house for My name.” Zechariah: “the BRANCH… shall build the temple of Yahweh… a priest on His throne.” What do these bring forward about the Son as Builder, and about what the house is?
